test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 15% per annum is Rs. 3,641, when the interest is compounded 8-monthly. The sum is:
solution:
**Given:**

Compound interest for 2 years at 15% per annum = Rs.3641

**Formulas used:**

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Compounded 8-monthly rate = 15% × 8/12 = 10% per 8-month

Time = 24/8 = 3 periods

3641 = P × (1 + 10/100)³ - P 

⇒ 3641 = P × 1331/1000 - P 

⇒ 3641 = P × 331/1000

⇒ P = 3641 × 1000/331 

⇒ P = 11000

**∴ The required sum is Rs.11000.**
